rows.note: Use 老婆 as the all-purpose colloquial word for “wife.”

example.english: My wife cooked curry chicken tonight.
example.traditional: 我老婆今晚煮咗咖喱雞。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lou5 po4 gam1 maan5 zyu2 zo2 gaa3 lei1 gai1

rows.note: Use 太太 as a polite way to refer to one’s wife, especially someone else’s.

example.english: Mr. Chan's wife is very polite.
example.traditional: 陳先生嘅太太好有禮貌。
example.jyutping: can4 sin1 saang1 ge3 taai3 taai3 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use 妻子 mainly in formal or written contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: The application form asks for the name of the wife.
example.traditional: 申請表上要填寫妻子姓名。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 biu2 soeng6 jiu3 tin4 se2 cai1 zi2 sing3 ming4
